title: Midnight orders promised the wrong delivery date

actionItems.text: Add a regression test for promisedDeliveryDate that fails on the buggy commit and passes on the fix
Write and enforce a Semgrep rule flagging raw Date methods outside util/time.js
Fix loyalty.js and reports/daily.js to use util/time.js helpers
Update on-call runbook: add TZ check as first step for date/time anomaly alerts
Run regression test and rule scan in CI on every PR touching src/
